rationale: Y has the most specific, convincing product UI (multitrack waveforms, timecoded edit log with a held legal claim), an expressive italic serif headline, and a warm, cohesive palette with distinctive extras such as the timeline bar and the dark planning-call CTA. X is bold and characterful with a tilted master-console visual and a stamp, but it is slightly busier and its pricing and feature cards are denser. Z is clean and competent but reads as the standard teal-and-cream SaaS layout with a generic card-and-timeline hero and uniform sections, so it is the most template-like.
